goal: Prevent light clients from disconnecting or banning nodes when requested block filters are not yet indexed
Ensure nodes reliably answer BIP 157 compact filter requests for newly announced blocks
agreement: Support because slow filter calculations cause frequent races even without compact block relay (ajtowns)
Support for handling filter races in peer processing to prevent peer disconnects (mzumsande)
Author addressed suggestions on retry throttling, idle timeouts, and message coverage (ajtowns, mzumsande)
Open maintenance request to update the PR description for the revised approach (ajtowns)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because light clients disconnect or ban Bitcoin Core nodes when filter indexing lags behind block relay
Resolves an interoperability failure that penalizes nodes serving BIP 157 compact filters to light clients
